name: Spherical Harmonics Initialization
definition: Initializes spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients for 3D Gaussian splatting by setting only the zeroth-order (DC) term from RGB colors.
summary: Spherical Harmonics Initialization sets initial view-dependent color coefficients for 3D Gaussian splats by mapping RGB inputs to the zeroth-order term, differing from evaluation by preparing parameters for optimization rather than computing colors during rendering.
